purpose: Make the visible vegetable beds match the plots and plant growth saved by the game.

background.prompt: Outdoor Japanese kitchen garden in warm hand-painted gouache: sky, low fence, flowering branches, open cultivated soil and mossy stone path. No indoor counter, no built-in raised boxes, no decorative rows of vegetables that the player cannot tend, no people or text. Leave the central soil clear for one to four interactive plots.

bed.prompt: Isolated transparent in-ground vegetable plot, a shallow oval rectangular mound of tilled dark soil with two furrows and small stones, low earthen edge, no wooden planter, crop, pot, scenery or text. Match the garden gouache style.

plantSheets.prompt: Four separate transparent scallion clusters rooted directly in soil, one horizontal row: small seedling, young greens, mature harvestable scallions, drooping wilted scallions. No wooden box, pot, scenery or labels; consistent gouache style and shared ground baseline.

Four separate transparent daisy clusters rooted directly in soil, one horizontal row: seedling, leafy closed buds, open cream flowers, drooping wilted flowers. No container, scenery or labels; consistent gouache style and shared ground baseline.

Four separate transparent compact yuzu shrubs rooted directly in soil, one horizontal row: seedling, green unripe fruit, small yellow ripe fruit, drooping wilted shrub. No container, scenery or labels; consistent gouache style and shared ground baseline.

processing: scripts/prepare-garden-field-art.mjs slices the three 2172x724 transparent sheets at transparent gutters, keeps stage scale and baseline in 720x700 frames, trims the soil bed and exports WebP.
